name: Man'in Densha
source:
Main character uses special medicine to seduce women in trains. One day all his team gets arrested all at once. When he runs away from police, he gets to know about an information store to leak that information. He develops a revenge plan.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-may-2003-ashita-deatta.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公利用特殊药物在电车上诱奸女性。一天，他的整个团伙突然全部遭到逮捕。逃避警方追捕时，他得知是一家情报商店泄露了消息，于是开始策划复仇。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-may-2003-ashita-deatta.html]vndbreview[/url]]
